limitations: This is a provisional browser assessment of the attached sheets and supplied runtime narrative; no tools, source files, other graders or prior-round reports were inspected.
Scores use the full browser range without a blanket native-evidence penalty; most remaining deductions concern visible task density, spacing, affordances or incomplete state-specific evidence.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1), excluding null dimensions.
The authorized threshold is not met: numerous screens and components have A or F below 9.
No confirmed hard-gate failure is established by these screenshots; content below a viewport or behind a scroll boundary is not by itself proof of an unreachable control.

Some enlarged captures begin partway through content; the supplied current onboarding focus and scroll checks are acknowledged, but capture ordering cannot independently establish which image represents the corrected entry moment.
Normal and transition captures show visual continuity, while temporal continuity, input response and performance rely on supplied runtime evidence rather than static images.
Reported contrast, axe, target-size, scaling, persistence, reduced-motion and timing checks were not independently rerun, and their complete measurement artifacts were not inspected.
Circles is demonstrated offline and Sky uses disclosed samples; enabled social states, production cloud behavior and authentication are not established.

Export preparing, completion and recovery images explicitly come from unchanged previous-round coverage; they support the stated browser boundary but are not fresh captures of every current export state.
Synthetic reading and source text is treated as layout material, not as a production-copy defect or evidence of model quality.
Physical iPhone Safari, VoiceOver, native text settings, real keyboard behavior, microphone, haptics, payments and OS share delivery remain unverified.
No novice-user study, production reliability study or predictive-accuracy evidence is supplied; no full/native 9 or 10 certification is made.
topFixes: Reduce decorative vertical space at 200% on Home, onboarding, birth forms, Sky and sharing while preserving exact text scaling.
Standardize secondary-action styling and keep skip, cancel and return actions close to their primary task.
Improve long evidence pages with explicit section labels and tighter question/answer and source grouping.
Clarify teen-safe defaults, empty-omen meaning and nearby-town consequences using brief task-specific copy.
Add enlarged Circles coverage and verify long-wait updates, exit consequences and status announcements at their actual interaction boundaries.
Retain the strong contextual recovery patterns, then complete physical iPhone and assistive-technology verification separately.
